reviewed_algorithm: Every sorted source-edge target belongs to the input mesh; head counts and exact frozen poor IDs are checked. All group members must be free on the same original cap loop; no diameter or displacement rejection is introduced.

Each existing member is ranked on its complete surviving non-cap side star while other groups remain unchanged. Degenerate/reversed/empty stars reject; maximum minimum retained native quality wins and exact score ties use lower local source ID. Shared side faces are recorded and the simultaneous map is checked without Cartesian backtracking.

Both mapped cycles retain their old association, only consecutive duplicate IDs are removed, and repeated/shared vertices reject. Exact polygon simplicity, nonzero area, cross-loop touching/intersection rejection and exact nesting/winding are checked before containment classification.

One exact-kernel CDT inserts retained boundary coordinates and both loop constraints plus every frozen exterior cap edge. Constructor-requiring constraint intersections reject. Validity/count plus a complete finite-vertex exact coordinate-map check prohibits new points; info fields are assigned from that map rather than trusted defaults.

Finite CDT faces are selected by exact mapped outer-minus-inner containment, never default all-constraint parity. Valid planar CDT embedding, exact area and full oriented boundary equality plus local links/Euler0/one component/two loops support coverage of the declared mapped domain.

All frozen exterior cap triangles must survive by exact cyclic oriented keys. For head this is all38. All final source coordinate bits, fixed vertices, exterior face keys and full local patch boundary/links/components/Euler are checked on the combined result.

Quality threshold2/29 and nonworsening minimum are evaluated after quotient plus CDT. Surviving side normals and every final affected-neighbor unchanged1e8/one-degree predicate remain; full changed triangles are tested against the immutable local reference envelope.

Output vertex origins are unique retained local d2af coordinate IDs. Quotient-side and exact frozen cap faces keep actual source face IDs; new cap-domain faces use UINT64_MAX, without invented old-cap preimages. Geometry/provenance export occurs after local predicates.
